scope: Read-only source revalidation and creation/review of a correction plan. No framework implementation, installation, external tracker write, commit or publication.

verification.check: ASDS official tests selected explicitly under tests/*.test.js
Accelerate Agy installer pytest in disposable fixture root

verification.level: structured boundary, not model or harness qualification

verification.check: Plan index/contracts bijection and dependency graph
Plan required task fields, whitespace, fences and acceptance owner references

independent_review.qualification: Accepted as a future correction work order subject to its explicit authorization gates. No material blocker reported. Plan does not make ASDS the executor.
independent_review.evidence_observed: Reviewer transcript records full paged plan reads, local authority/code checks, independent dependency validation, baseline hashes and completed verdict. Parent independently checked final plan hash and graph.
independent_review.review_is_not: Implementation approval, user authorization, model qualification, provider capability proof or guarantee of future plan quality.

limits: No full Accelerate shell-catalog suite in this revalidation.
No Plane API capability study or mutation.
No global Hermes or other harness configuration changed.
T09 publication strategy and any exceptional temporary copy/retention still need the specified design/authorization gate before implementation.
